item.title: BTS Let Off Steam After a Big Night In ‘NORMAL’ Music Video: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about the latest music video from K-pop superstars BTS. Their new video for 'NORMAL' is out now, and it's a must-see."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Directed by Ukrainian filmmaker Tanu Muino, the video features all seven members of BTS, showcasing intimate and personal moments. The clip is set in a stunning old mansion, complete with empty wine glasses and flashbacks. And, of course, some adorable dogs and a swan make an appearance too."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "The video is part of BTS' latest studio album ARIRANG, and 'NORMAL' is the second single from the album, following the hit song 'SWIM'. Speaking of hits, 'SWIM' reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in April, and ARIRANG topped the Billboard 200 chart."
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "BTS is currently on tour, with concerts scheduled in Continental Europe, including two shows in Paris this weekend. And, exciting news, they'll be joining Justin Bieber, Madonna, and Shakira as co-headliners at the first FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show in New Jersey on July 19th."
[Soft music returns]
Host: "To watch the 'NORMAL' music video, Spotify Premium subscribers can search for the song and switch to video mode. And, for a full-screen experience on mobile, simply turn your device to landscape mode. Stream the 'NORMAL' EP now and check out the video for yourself."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you in the next episode!"
